metadata.description: Partial checklist for remaining properties (batch 2 of iterative generation)

checklist.title: Verify STATE-EL-BLOCK-INVALID correctly rejects invalid blocks without affecting persistent state
detection_procedure: 1. Locate block validation logic in core/blockchain.go and eth/catalyst/api.go
2. Trace the path from newPayload processing to invalid block detection
3. Verify that transactional state is used during block processing (statedb snapshot/copy)
4. Confirm that on validation failure (state root mismatch, gas limit violation, tx failure):
a. The working state is discarded completely
b. No writes to persistent database occur
c. INVALID response is returned with appropriate latestValidHash
5. Check that EDGE-BLOCK-INVALID-EXEC and EDGE-INVALID-RESPOND are the only outgoing paths
6. Verify error propagation includes proper error codes for debugging
7. Test: Submit payload with incorrect state root and verify clean rejection
checklist.notes: Traceability: Property PROP-NODE-STATE-EL-BLOCK-INVALID-001 → State STATE-EL-BLOCK-INVALID. Block processing uses transactional state. On failure, all changes are discarded. INVALID response includes latestValidHash for chain recovery.

checklist.title: Verify ACTION-EL-COMMIT-STATE is only reachable from STATE-EL-BLOCK-VALID
detection_procedure: 1. Locate state commit action in core/state/statedb.go Commit()
2. Trace all call paths leading to statedb.Commit()
3. Verify each path originates from successful block validation (STATE-EL-BLOCK-VALID)
4. Confirm state root verification occurs before commit (computed == expected)
5. Check that no path from block processing calls Commit before verification
6. Verify EDGE-VALID-COMMIT is the only incoming edge to this action
7. Check atomicity: partial state changes cannot be committed
8. Verify MPT provides integrity verification on commit

executable_checks.command: trace call graph from InsertChain/newPayload to statedb.Commit
executable_checks.assertion: All paths pass through validation success check

checklist.notes: Traceability: Property PROP-NODE-ACTION-EL-COMMIT-STATE-001 → Action ACTION-EL-COMMIT-STATE. State commitment is atomic and only occurs after complete validation. Merkle Patricia Trie provides integrity verification.

checklist.title: Verify STATE-EL-NEWPAYLOAD-RESPONSE-READY contains accurate payload status reflecting true validation result
detection_procedure: 1. Locate newPayload response construction in eth/catalyst/api.go
2. Trace the two paths to response ready state:
a. EDGE-COMMIT-RESPOND from successful validation → VALID status
b. EDGE-INVALID-RESPOND from failure → INVALID status
3. Verify status is set correctly on each path (no status confusion)
4. Confirm VALID is only returned after state root verification passes
5. Check DATA-PAYLOAD-STATUS structure matches Engine API spec
6. Verify latestValidHash is correctly computed on INVALID response
7. Test: Submit valid and invalid payloads and verify correct status responses

executable_checks.assertion: Payload status constants and handling exist

checklist.notes: Traceability: Property PROP-NODE-STATE-EL-NEWPAYLOAD-RESPONSE-READY-001 → State STATE-EL-NEWPAYLOAD-RESPONSE-READY. Response integrity is critical for consensus client decision making. VALID only after full validation.

checklist.title: Verify ACTION-EL-GET-PAYLOAD requires valid payload ID from authenticated prior request
detection_procedure: 1. Locate getPayload handlers (GetPayloadV1/V2/V3/V4) in eth/catalyst/api.go
2. Verify JWT authentication is required (via Engine API namespace)
3. Trace PayloadID validation logic:
a. ID format verification
b. ID must exist in active builds map
c. ID corresponds to build from authenticated request
4. Verify payload retrieval only from STATE-EL-PAYLOAD-BUILDING state
5. Check for payload expiration handling
6. Verify error response for invalid/unknown PayloadID
7. Confirm no payload ID enumeration vulnerabilities

executable_checks.assertion: GetPayload handlers with PayloadID validation exist

checklist.notes: Traceability: Property PROP-NODE-ACTION-EL-GET-PAYLOAD-001 → Action ACTION-EL-GET-PAYLOAD. JWT authentication required. Payload ID must match active build from authenticated forkchoiceUpdated request.

checklist.title: Verify STATE-EL-PAYLOAD-RETURNED contains valid, correctly-formed execution payload
detection_procedure: 1. Locate payload building in miner/payload_building.go or miner/worker.go
2. Verify payload construction process:
a. Only validated transactions from pending pool are included
b. Block headers are correctly computed (hash, state root, etc.)
c. Transaction root matches Merkle root of included transactions
3. For Cancun+: Verify blob sidecar handling:
a. KZG commitments match blob content
b. Proofs are correctly generated
4. Verify payload is built by trusted ACTOR-MINER-BUILDER
5. Check block hash integrity before return
6. Verify DATA-EXECUTION-PAYLOAD and DATA-BLOB-SIDECAR structure compliance
checklist.notes: Traceability: Property PROP-NODE-STATE-EL-PAYLOAD-RETURNED-001 → State STATE-EL-PAYLOAD-RETURNED. Payload built internally using validated transactions. CL will propose; network consensus validates.

checklist.title: Verify STATE-USER-SUBMITTING-TX input is treated as untrusted and fully validated
detection_procedure: 1. Locate eth_sendRawTransaction handler in internal/ethapi/api.go
2. Verify all paths from external input lead to validation:
a. RLP decoding with error handling
b. Signature verification before any processing
c. Nonce, balance, gas validation in txpool
3. Check that ACTOR-EXTERNAL-USER trust level is UNTRUSTED
4. Verify no assumptions about input format/validity
5. Check for panic/crash handling on malformed input
6. Verify rate limiting or DoS protections on RPC endpoint
7. Confirm transaction data never trusted without validation

executable_checks.assertion: RPC handler for transaction submission exists
Transaction decoding with error handling exists

checklist.notes: Traceability: Property PROP-NODE-STATE-USER-SUBMITTING-TX-001 → State STATE-USER-SUBMITTING-TX. Primary attack surface. ACTOR-EXTERNAL-USER has UNTRUSTED trust level. All data must be validated before acceptance.

checklist.title: Verify ACTION-EL-VALIDATE-TX performs comprehensive transaction validation
detection_procedure: 1. Locate validateTx in core/txpool/legacypool/legacypool.go
2. Verify complete validation checklist:
a. secp256k1 signature verification
b. Nonce check (tx.nonce >= account.nonce)
c. Balance check (balance >= gas * gasPrice + value)
d. Gas limit bounds (tx.gas >= intrinsicGas, tx.gas <= blockGasLimit)
e. Transaction size limit
f. EIP-specific validation (1559 fee caps, 2930 access lists, 4844 blobs)
3. Verify exactly two outcomes: EDGE-TX-VALID → STATE-TX-PENDING, EDGE-TX-INVALID → STATE-TX-REJECTED
4. Confirm no path bypasses any validation check
5. Check error messages for each validation failure
checklist.notes: Traceability: Property PROP-NODE-ACTION-EL-VALIDATE-TX-001 → Action ACTION-EL-VALIDATE-TX. Comprehensive validation: signature, nonce, balance >= gas * gasPrice + value, gas limits, EIP-specific checks.

checklist.title: Verify STATE-TX-REJECTED is terminal with no path to pool or block inclusion
detection_procedure: 1. Locate transaction rejection handling in core/txpool/
2. Verify STATE-TX-REJECTED has no outgoing edges to processing states
3. Confirm rejected transactions are never added to pending pool
4. Verify rejection response is returned to submitter immediately
5. Check that rejected transactions cannot be re-queued internally
6. Verify no state modifications occur for rejected transactions
7. Check logging/metrics for rejected transactions (for monitoring)
8. Verify error response format matches API specification
checklist.notes: Traceability: Property PROP-NODE-STATE-TX-REJECTED-001 → State STATE-TX-REJECTED. Terminal state for invalid transactions. No path to pool or block inclusion. Clean rejection without side effects.

checklist.title: Verify STATE-TX-PENDING only contains validated transactions
detection_procedure: 1. Locate pending pool in core/txpool/legacypool/legacypool.go
2. Verify the only incoming edge is EDGE-TX-VALID from ACTION-EL-VALIDATE-TX
3. Trace all paths that add transactions to pending:
a. AddLocal, AddRemote must call validateTx
b. Pool reset after reorg maintains invariant
c. Transaction promotion from queue validates again
4. Verify concurrent access doesn't corrupt invariant (mutex protection)
5. Check replacement transactions (same nonce, higher fee) are validated
6. Verify no internal injection paths bypass validation
7. Confirm signature is pre-verified for all pending transactions
checklist.notes: Traceability: Property PROP-NODE-STATE-TX-PENDING-001 → State STATE-TX-PENDING. Pool invariant: all transactions have passed signature verification and basic validation. Re-validation during block building.

checklist.title: Verify EDGE-JWT-VALID-FORKCHOICE only traversed after successful JWT validation
detection_procedure: 1. Locate JWT validation in node/jwt_handler.go
2. Trace request flow from HTTP handler to forkchoiceUpdated
3. Verify EDGE-JWT-VALID-FORKCHOICE originates from ACTION-EL-VALIDATE-JWT success path
4. Confirm invalid tokens lead to EDGE-JWT-INVALID (not this edge)
5. Verify condition: JWT signature valid AND token not expired (iat within ±60s)
6. Check no bypass path to ACTION-EL-PROCESS-FORKCHOICE without JWT check
7. Verify authentication state is correctly propagated to handler
checklist.notes: Traceability: Property PROP-EDGE-JWT-VALID-FORKCHOICE-001 → Edge EDGE-JWT-VALID-FORKCHOICE. Transition requires successful JWT validation. JWT signature must be verified before processing.

checklist.title: Verify EDGE-JWT-VALID-NEWPAYLOAD only traversed after successful JWT validation for newPayload
detection_procedure: 1. Locate newPayload handlers (NewPayloadV1/V2/V3/V4) in eth/catalyst/api.go
2. Verify registration under authenticated Engine API namespace
3. Trace request path to confirm JWT validation precedes payload processing
4. Verify EDGE-JWT-VALID-NEWPAYLOAD requires successful authentication
5. Confirm no direct path to ACTION-EL-PROCESS-NEWPAYLOAD bypasses JWT
6. Check graph structure enforces authentication before processing
7. Verify JWT signature verification for all Engine API methods
checklist.notes: Traceability: Property PROP-EDGE-JWT-VALID-NEWPAYLOAD-001 → Edge EDGE-JWT-VALID-NEWPAYLOAD. Only authenticated requests can reach payload processing. Graph structure ensures authentication precedes processing.

checklist.title: Verify EDGE-JWT-INVALID leads to terminal rejection with no further processing
detection_procedure: 1. Locate JWT validation failure handling in node/jwt_handler.go
2. Verify EDGE-JWT-INVALID leads to STATE-EL-JWT-REJECTED
3. Confirm no further Engine API processing occurs after rejection
4. Verify HTTP 401 Unauthorized response is returned
5. Check response does not leak sensitive information
6. Verify timing is constant to prevent side-channel attacks
7. Check logging for failed authentication attempts (for monitoring)
8. Confirm rejected requests cannot retry without new valid token

executable_checks.assertion: Error responses are returned on failure

checklist.notes: Traceability: Property PROP-EDGE-JWT-INVALID-001 → Edge EDGE-JWT-INVALID. Security enforcement path. Invalid tokens lead to definitive rejection. HTTP 401 Unauthorized returned.

checklist.title: Verify EDGE-FORKCHOICE-CHECK-BLOCK transfers fork choice state to block existence verification
detection_procedure: 1. Locate forkchoiceUpdated processing in eth/catalyst/api.go
2. Trace DATA-FORKCHOICE-STATE handling after JWT validation
3. Verify block existence check occurs for headBlockHash
4. Confirm ACTION-EL-CHECK-BLOCK-EXISTS is mandatory in processing path
5. Check that fork choice is never accepted without verifying head exists
6. Verify local chain database is queried for block
7. Check error handling for database lookup failures

executable_checks.assertion: Block lookup for fork choice exists

checklist.notes: Traceability: Property PROP-EDGE-FORKCHOICE-CHECK-BLOCK-001 → Edge EDGE-FORKCHOICE-CHECK-BLOCK. Fork choice head hash verified against local chain before acceptance. Integrity of local chain database assumed.

checklist.title: Verify EDGE-BLOCK-NOT-FOUND correctly routes to SYNCING state when head block missing
detection_procedure: 1. Locate block lookup failure handling in eth/catalyst/api.go
2. Verify missing head block leads to SYNCING status response
3. Confirm STATE-EL-SYNCING is reached via EDGE-BLOCK-NOT-FOUND
4. Check SYNCING response format matches Engine API spec
5. Verify no head update occurs when block is not found
6. Confirm this enables proper sync coordination with CL
7. Verify block sync is initiated when needed
checklist.notes: Traceability: Property PROP-EDGE-BLOCK-NOT-FOUND-001 → Edge EDGE-BLOCK-NOT-FOUND. Correct behavior for missing blocks. SYNCING response allows CL to initiate block sync.

checklist.title: Verify EDGE-BLOCK-FOUND-SET-HEAD only traverses when block exists locally
detection_procedure: 1. Locate head setting logic in eth/catalyst/api.go
2. Verify EDGE-BLOCK-FOUND-SET-HEAD condition: block lookup succeeded
3. Confirm canonical head is only set to verified, locally-present blocks
4. Verify DATA-BLOCK is retrieved from local database, not from request
5. Check ACTION-EL-SET-CANONICAL-HEAD uses local block data
6. Verify no path allows setting head to non-existent block
7. Confirm block validity was previously established (for imported blocks)
checklist.notes: Traceability: Property PROP-EDGE-BLOCK-FOUND-SET-HEAD-001 → Edge EDGE-BLOCK-FOUND-SET-HEAD. Canonical head only set to blocks that exist locally. Block retrieved from local database.

checklist.title: Verify EDGE-HEAD-SET-UPDATE-FINALIZED ensures proper sequencing of chain state updates
detection_procedure: 1. Locate finalized/safe block update logic in eth/catalyst/api.go
2. Verify ordering: canonical head set BEFORE finalized/safe update
3. Confirm ACTION-EL-UPDATE-FINALIZED-SAFE only has incoming edge from ACTION-EL-SET-CANONICAL-HEAD
4. Check chain state consistency invariant is maintained
5. Verify finalized block hash from DATA-FORKCHOICE-STATE is validated
6. Confirm finalized must be ancestor of (or equal to) head
7. Verify safe block is between finalized and head
8. Check atomicity of finalized/safe updates
checklist.notes: Traceability: Property PROP-EDGE-HEAD-SET-UPDATE-FINALIZED-001 → Edge EDGE-HEAD-SET-UPDATE-FINALIZED. Finalized blocks are irreversible. Proper sequencing ensures consistency: head set first, then finalized/safe.

checklist.title: Verify EDGE-CHECK-PAYLOAD-ATTRS only traverses when PayloadAttributes are provided
detection_procedure: 1. Locate PayloadAttributes handling in eth/catalyst/api.go forkchoiceUpdated
2. Verify block building is ONLY initiated when PayloadAttributes present
3. Confirm edge condition requires PayloadAttributes != nil
4. Check without PayloadAttributes, EDGE-NO-PAYLOAD-ATTRS is taken instead
5. Verify DATA-PAYLOAD-ATTRIBUTES contains required fields:
a. Timestamp (must be > parent)
b. PrevRandao (for post-merge)
c. SuggestedFeeRecipient
6. Confirm block building is explicitly requested, not automatic
checklist.notes: Traceability: Property PROP-EDGE-CHECK-PAYLOAD-ATTRS-001 → Edge EDGE-CHECK-PAYLOAD-ATTRS. Block building explicitly requested via PayloadAttributes. Includes timestamp, prevRandao, feeRecipient.

checklist.title: Verify EDGE-NO-PAYLOAD-ATTRS handles forkchoiceUpdated without block building
detection_procedure: 1. Locate forkchoiceUpdated handling for absent PayloadAttributes
2. Verify no block building occurs when PayloadAttributes is nil
3. Confirm direct path to STATE-EL-FORKCHOICE-RESPONSE-READY
4. Check response does not include PayloadID (no build started)
5. Verify this path is used for pure chain head updates
6. Confirm no resources are allocated for payload building
7. Verify response is returned immediately without building delay

executable_checks.assertion: No PayloadID returned when no build

checklist.notes: Traceability: Property PROP-EDGE-NO-PAYLOAD-ATTRS-001 → Edge EDGE-NO-PAYLOAD-ATTRS. ForkchoiceUpdated can be called purely for chain head updates without block building.

checklist.title: Verify EDGE-PAYLOAD-BUILD-STARTED uses only validated transactions from pool
detection_procedure: 1. Locate payload building initiation in miner/worker.go or miner/payload_building.go
2. Verify transactions are sourced from STATE-TX-PENDING (validated pool)
3. Confirm no direct transaction injection bypasses pool
4. Check DATA-TRANSACTION references are to pre-validated pending transactions
5. Verify pool invariant (all pending txs validated) is maintained
6. Confirm transaction signatures are pre-verified in pool
7. Check transaction ordering respects gas price priority
checklist.notes: Traceability: Property PROP-EDGE-PAYLOAD-BUILD-STARTED-001 → Edge EDGE-PAYLOAD-BUILD-STARTED. Block builder selects from validated pending pool. Transaction signatures pre-verified.

checklist.title: Verify EDGE-PAYLOAD-BUILD-RESPONSE returns unique, valid PayloadID
detection_procedure: 1. Locate PayloadID generation in eth/catalyst/api.go
2. Verify PayloadID is uniquely generated for each build request
3. Confirm ID cannot be predicted or enumerated
4. Check ID is correctly associated with ongoing build
5. Verify response includes valid PayloadID in forkchoiceUpdated response
6. Confirm PayloadID is required for subsequent getPayload call
7. Check for payload ID collision prevention
8. Verify format matches Engine API specification
checklist.notes: Traceability: Property PROP-EDGE-PAYLOAD-BUILD-RESPONSE-001 → Edge EDGE-PAYLOAD-BUILD-RESPONSE. PayloadID uniquely identifies build session. Required for payload retrieval.
